headline.title: Microsoft Build 2026: The 7 biggest announcements
headline.summary: Microsoft Build 2026 featured key announcements from CEO Satya Nadella, including new Surface hardware, an always-on personal assistant, and updates to the company's AI models. The event showcased a range of innovations aimed at enhancing user experience and integrating AI across Microsoft's products.

articles.title: Uber caps employee AI spending after blowing through budget in 4 months
articles.summary: Uber has implemented a cap on employee spending for AI initiatives after exceeding its budget within just four months. This decision follows the company's prior encouragement for staff to leverage AI technologies extensively.

articles.title: Travelers deploys AI-powered claims countrywide with OpenAI
articles.summary: Travelers has launched an AI-powered Claim Assistant in partnership with OpenAI to assist customers in filing claims and offer round-the-clock support. This technology aims to enhance operational efficiency, especially during periods of high demand.

articles.title: Microsoft Build 2026: All the news about Windows, AI, RTX Spark, and more
articles.summary: Microsoft Build 2026 unveiled several key updates, including developer-focused enhancements for Windows, the introduction of the AI assistant Scout, and the Majorana 2 quantum computing chip. Additionally, the event showcased a new Surface mini PC for AI developers and announced Project Solara, an Android-based OS tailored for AI-driven devices.

articles.title: Trump signs executive order to review AI models before they’re released
articles.summary: President Donald Trump signed an executive order establishing a voluntary framework for AI companies to share their advanced models with the federal government prior to release. The initiative aims to enhance cybersecurity and promote secure innovation within the US AI industry.

articles.title: Microsoft’s first advanced reasoning AI is here
articles.summary: Microsoft unveiled its new advanced reasoning AI model, MAI-Thinking-1, at the Build 2026 conference, marking a significant shift in its AI development strategy. This release follows the company's previous reliance on OpenAI's models and comes after a renegotiated partnership between the two firms.

articles.title: Martin Scorsese becomes the latest — and most unlikely — Hollywood voice for AI
articles.summary: Martin Scorsese has embraced AI technology for storyboarding in his filmmaking process, marking a notable shift for the acclaimed director. This move highlights the growing acceptance of AI tools in Hollywood, albeit in a limited capacity.

articles.title: Anthropic scales Claude Mythos to critical infrastructure in 15+ countries
articles.summary: Anthropic is expanding its Project Glasswing security vulnerability program and access to its AI model, Claude Mythos, to 150 organizations across 15 countries, focusing on critical infrastructure sectors such as power, water, healthcare, and communications. This initiative aims to enhance cybersecurity measures in areas where cyberattacks could impact up to 100 million people.

articles.title: Google’s Phone app will tell you if a scammer is impersonating one of your contacts
articles.summary: Google is introducing a feature in its Phone app that alerts users when a call from a number resembling a contact's is likely a scam. This enhancement aims to help protect users from AI impersonation scams by flagging suspicious calls.

articles.title: Microsoft’s Project Solara is an OS for AI agent gadgets
articles.summary: Microsoft has unveiled "Project Solara," a new operating system tailored for gadgets that utilize AI agents, during the Build 2026 conference. Built on Android rather than Windows, the platform aims to facilitate agent-driven experiences, with two concept devices, the Desk concept and a badge, showcased at the event.

articles.title: Microsoft launches Scout, an OpenClaw-inspired personal assistant
articles.summary: Microsoft has introduced Scout, a new AI personal assistant designed to integrate the capabilities of OpenClaw into the Microsoft 365 ecosystem. The announcement was made during the Build conference.

articles.title: Amazon faces class action lawsuit over Ring facial-recognition feature
articles.summary: Amazon is facing a class action lawsuit in Seattle over its Ring facial-recognition feature, Familiar Faces, which allegedly stores images of individuals without their consent. The lawsuit was initiated by Virginia resident Charles Sigwalt, raising concerns about privacy violations.
